title: SB2288 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, authorizes a registered student at a public institution of higher education to carry a handgun in a concealed manner on property owned, operated, or controlled by that institution if the student is a handgun carry permit holder and otherwise in compliance with state law. - Amends TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13 and Title 49.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2020-02-04; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513193304 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/111/Bill/SB2288.pdf (LegiScan doc 2120932))
provenance.note: Draft dated 2020-02-04, shared with twin HB 2102. Adds subdivision (e)(14) to the list of exceptions in 39-17-1309; the caption also cites Title 49 but no Title 49 section appears in the text.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-1309(e)(14)): (14) Registered students of a public institution of higher education who are: (A) Authorized to carry a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1351 or § 39-17- 1366; (B) On property owned, operated, or controlled by the public institution of higher education at which the student is registered; (C) Carrying the handgun in a concealed manner; and (D) Otherwise in compliance with state law.
